subscription.description: A piece of code that you should run.

userCreated.description: Execute onboarding script when a new user registers.

orderPaid.description: Trigger invoice generation after an order is marked as paid.

dailyBackup.description: Run database backup every night at 02:00 UTC.

description:
We have set up three server‑side subscriptions to handle key events in our platform. When a new user registers, the **userCreated** subscription will execute the onboarding script to get the user started. Once an order status changes to paid, the **orderPaid** subscription will trigger the invoice generation process automatically.

In addition, a nightly maintenance task has been scheduled: the **dailyBackup** subscription runs a full database backup each night at 02:00 UTC to ensure data safety and recoverability.
